API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ManagementGet Forwarding Rules Count
Get Forwarding Rules Count
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecRules/ecRdr/count

Retrieves the count of traffic forwarding rules available in the Cloud & Branch Connector Admin Portal.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
predefinedRuleCount
boolean

Indicates whether the count of predefined rules is retrieved (true) or the count all rules is retrieved (false).

Default value: false
ruleName
string

The search string used to match against the rule name.

ruleOrder
string

The search string used to match against the rule order.

ruleDescription
string

The search string used to match against the rule description.

ruleForwardMethod
string

Possible values: [INVALID, DIRECT, PROXYCHAIN, ZIA, ZPA, ECZPA, ECSELF, DROP, ENATDEDIP, GEOIP]

The search string used to match against the rule forwarding method. Supported values are ZIA, ZPA, DIRECT, and DROP.

location
string

The search string used to match against the locations or sublocations used in rule configurations.

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
SCHEMA
integer
int32
